}}'''Naiselle''' is a banker from [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Naiselle}} She has cool eyes. She is not a channeler and most probably is [[Altara]]n.
==Activities==
She is at the [[Kin]]'s [[farm]] when [[Elayne]] and the rest appear and [[Travel]]s with them to [[Andor]] when the [[Seanchan]] attack. [[Alise]] assigns her to washing dishes along with nine others who were too slow in packing their belonging.
